summary.intent: Fix YAML frontmatter missing from two newly created todo files so the GSD planning tooling can parse them, then commit and push to open a PR.
summary.outcome: Both todo files received proper YAML frontmatter (converting H1 headings to title fields matching existing conventions), were verified to parse correctly, committed, and pushed.

repo: GSD todo files under .planning/todos/pending/ require YAML frontmatter with at least a title: field; a bare H1 heading is not sufficient for the parser.

code.finding: File lacked YAML frontmatter; H1 title had to be converted to a title: frontmatter field.
Same issue: missing YAML frontmatter causing parse failure.

workflow: Always verify todo files parse via GSD tooling before committing to catch missing frontmatter early.

friction: Two todo files were created without the required YAML frontmatter, requiring a follow-up fix before the PR could be opened.
